import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents


class DocumentAccessTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.addCleanup(self.connection.close)
        initialize(self.connection)
        self.connection.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            [
                (8, "tenant", "owner", "Last", "Last body", None),
                (1, "tenant", "owner", "First", "First body", None),
                (2, "other tenant", "owner", "Private", "Body", None),
                (3, "tenant", "other owner", "Private", "Body", None),
                (4, "tenant", "owner", "Deleted", "Body", "2026-01-01"),
                (5, "tenant", "owner", "Deleted", "Body", ""),
                (6, "tenant's", "owner's", "Quoted", "Quoted body", None),
                (7, "' OR 1=1 --", "' OR 1=1 --", "Literal", "Body", None),
            ],
        )

    def test_get_requires_live_document_in_both_scopes(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", 1),
            {"id": 1, "title": "First", "body": "First body"},
        )
        for document_id in (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 99):
            with self.subTest(document_id=document_id):
                self.assertIsNone(
                    get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", document_id)
                )

    def test_listing_is_scoped_ordered_and_has_only_result_fields(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            list_documents(self.connection, "tenant", "owner"),
            [
                {"id": 1, "title": "First", "body": "First body"},
                {"id": 8, "title": "Last", "body": "Last body"},
            ],
        )
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "missing", "owner"), [])
        self.assertEqual(list_documents(self.connection, "tenant", "missing"), [])

    def test_names_and_ids_are_bound_as_literal_values(self):
        for tenant, owner, document_id, title, body in (
            ("tenant's", "owner's", 6, "Quoted", "Quoted body"),
            ("' OR 1=1 --", "' OR 1=1 --", 7, "Literal", "Body"),
        ):
            with self.subTest(tenant=tenant):
                expected = {"id": document_id, "title": title, "body": body}
                self.assertEqual(
                    get_document(self.connection, tenant, owner, document_id), expected
                )
                self.assertEqual(
                    list_documents(self.connection, tenant, owner), [expected]
                )
                self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, tenant, "owner", 1))
                self.assertIsNone(get_document(self.connection, "tenant", owner, 1))
        self.assertIsNone(
            get_document(self.connection, "tenant", "owner", "1 OR 1=1")
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
